script_text: Stop—Cancer, the sky just handed you a key you've ignored for months, and time is finally running out. As a Water sign ruled by the Moon, your deep feelings are the engine, and right now the Sun at precisely 22 degrees Scorpio forms a grounded trine with Saturn in Pisces across your 9th House of Expansion, rewarding patience over impulse. Meanwhile, Neptune drifts through your 10th House of Career, blurring one important contract. In love, the Sun ignites your 5th House of Romance: singles attract a serious, commitment-minded partner, while couples must voice one unspoken truth tonight. Jupiter moving slowly through Leo in your 2nd House signals a delayed payment or bonus finally landing, while Pluto stirs shared debts in your 8th House. Warning: avoid emotional spending. One beautiful unexpected gift arrives—an old message returning. Follow for tomorrow's reading before the Moon changes signs.
